answer: The Commission cannot impose the standard penalties of imprisonment or heavy fines (up to one crore rupees) on farmers for causing air pollution through stubble burning. There are six AQI categories, and the overall AQI value is determined by the worst sub-index among the monitored pollutants [naqi-2014::fixed::c000]. 

The six categories are Good, Satisfactory, Moderately polluted, Poor, Very Poor, and Severe [naqi-2014::fixed::c000]. The index is calculated based on the ambient concentrations of eight pollutants: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, CO, O3, NH3, and Pb [naqi-2014::fixed::c000]. A sub-index is calculated for each pollutant, and the highest (worst) sub-index determines the final AQI value [ncap-2019::fixed::c019].
